column1: # derivation: §4.2: a key that states NULLS FIRST sorts its NULLs first,
# whatever its direction. a by id: 3, NULL, 1, 3, NULL, 2, 3. NULLs (id 2,
# 5), then 1 (id 3), 2 (id 6), 3 (id 1, 4, 7). Rows tying on a come in no
# promised order (§4.7), so each tie group compares as a multiset.
# Types: a sort keeps its input columns, as scanned.
